Name: Flower Boxes (cCustomfurniture)
Author: devilsandswords
Description:
[u]06/10/2019:
NEW! [/u]
3 tile planter boxes for custom furniture! 2 boxes per flower, each with 3 different colour versions. Simply rotate to use the other colours. 

Custom farming Redux versions of this mod are on Hiatus for now. 


As lovely as the basegame house plants are, there's always room for more flowers! This gives you the ability to place boxes full of the 6 basegame crop flowers in your house, each with 6 different colour palettes to choose from!
Each box is labelled left or right, with one of each direction per flower. In all, including the 2 different grass boxes, there are 26 items to buy and place, but totals up to nearly 80 different flowers and grasses to use! 

Each flower has 4 normal colour palettes similar to the colours of  those you can grow, and 2 colour palettes that are little odd and maybe a little unrealistic. If you don't happen to like a box's colours, there's no need to use it!
This can be used with Customfurniture anywhere to help furnish your farm!

[u]INSTALLATION:
[/u]Download, and unzip folder, and place the [CF] folder into your mods folder. Custom Furniture will do the rest!
 

[b]NEW![/b]
Optional Customfarming folder enabling you to craft these boxes and place them around your farm!
This folder can be placed in the customcontent folder of Customfarming to give you the ability to craft the boxes and place them around your farm! Compatible with the Customfurniture boxes, so no need to choose between buying and making.
